summary: Patient forgot the visit because she did not receive a reminder message, and wishes to reschedule for next week.
recommended_action: Reschedule the appointment for next week and verify the patient's contact number for future reminders.

summary: The patient missed the appointment because the clinic is too far away and they could not find transport.
recommended_action: Offer telemedicine options or assist with transport coordination for future visits.

summary: Patient missed the appointment because the consultation fee was too high and inquired about follow-up discounts.
recommended_action: Inform the patient about any available discount policies or low-cost follow-up options.

summary: Patient had high fever and body ache on the appointment day, stayed in bed, and plans to visit once recovered.
recommended_action: Schedule a follow-up call in one week to check on recovery and rebook the appointment.

summary: Patient missed the appointment because of an urgent office meeting and requested an evening slot for the next visit.
recommended_action: Reschedule the patient for an evening slot and update their preferred appointment time.

summary: Patient forgot the appointment because they did not receive an SMS reminder and now wishes to rebook.
recommended_action: Help the patient reschedule their appointment and verify their mobile number for future SMS reminders.

summary: Patient missed the appointment due to a city bus strike and lack of available transport near their colony.
recommended_action: Offer telehealth options or assistance with transportation planning for future visits.

summary: Patient phone was switched off and could not be reached after three attempts.
recommended_action: Attempt to contact the patient again via phone at a later time or send an SMS.

summary: Patient missed the appointment due to a factory shift change and inability to take leave.
recommended_action: Reschedule the appointment for a Saturday.
